message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has found a common slot and booked the meeting. My remaining task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners. I will draft a confirmation email and use the `send_confirmation_email` function. The meeting is on Thursday, November 19 at 2:30 PM. I will then end my session.

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments:
{"day":"Thu","body":"Dear Partners,
